about.title: Hercules Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone in a traffic collision changes everything, and the practical and legal questions that follow can feel like too much to carry alongside grief. Hercules sits along busy corridors like I-80, San Pablo Avenue, and SR-4, where Friday evening traffic between 5 and 7 p.m. tends to bring the most reported collisions in this Contra Costa County city. While 2025's final numbers show no traffic deaths recorded alongside 53 injury collisions, families in Hercules and nearby communities still face fatal outcomes from serious crashes in surrounding areas, and California law gives certain surviving family members a path to pursue accountability. A wrongful death claim is separate from any criminal case and focuses on the financial and emotional losses left behind. LawProactive doesn't practice law, but we can connect you with an independent attorney in our network who reviews wrongful death matters on a contingency basis, meaning there's no fee unless a recovery is made. Reaching out costs nothing and starts with a conversation about what happened.

whyChoose.title: Why Families in Hercules Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Are Specific
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before extending to other dependents. An attorney can help clarify where your family fits before time or eligibility issues arise.

items.title: The Clock Starts Immediately
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity, like a public roadway agency, may be involved. Acting sooner preserves options that can otherwise close quietly.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Bill
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial costs and lost financial support, but also for the loss of love, companionship, and guidance a family member provided. These are real losses the law recognizes, even without a dollar figure attached to grief.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children first. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the family structure. An independent attorney can review your specific situation to explain where you stand.

items.question: Does Hercules having zero recorded traffic deaths in the latest year affect our claim?
items.answer: No. That figure reflects one specific reporting year for the city, and fatal outcomes can still occur on Hercules-area roads or in crashes involving Hercules residents elsewhere. Your claim is evaluated on its own facts, not on citywide statistics.

items.question: How is a wrongful death claim different from a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: They're entirely separate processes with different purposes and outcomes. A criminal case addresses punishment for the driver, while a civil wrongful death claim addresses the financial and emotional losses suffered by surviving family. One can proceed regardless of the outcome of the other.
